scripts.test:unit: backend/.venv/bin/python -m pytest backend/tests/unit && npm --prefix frontend run test:unit
scripts.test:module: backend/.venv/bin/python -m pytest backend/tests/module && npm --prefix frontend run test:module
scripts.check: backend/.venv/bin/python -m mypy --config-file backend/mypy.ini backend/app environments && npm --prefix frontend run check
